_comment: Lincoln-Douglas resolutions before 2000, 1979-80 through 1998-99, verbatim from the NSDA past-topics archive (speechanddebate.org/topics), with the NSDA and NCFL Nationals topics. `year` is the season's ending year, matching debate-topics.json (1999-2000 onward lives there). `start_month` is the month a topic took effect: Nationals is June, NCFL Nationals May.
